question: GQ-001
subject: my own filters silently disabled five self-test cases
how_it_surfaced: the pre-push hook refused: gate self-test FAIL, five cases reporting GATE DID NOT FIRE — every one caused by a filter I added earlier the same day

the_five_causes_each_measured_not_guesse.cause: skip threshold of <10 commits in evaluate-refresh
the_five_causes_each_measured_not_guesse.why: the self-test builds a scratch repo with exactly TWO commits on purpose — two minimum because the gate excludes HEAD
the_five_causes_each_measured_not_guesse.fix: threshold is ONE, the only count that genuinely cannot be measured

the_five_causes_each_measured_not_guesse.cause: a bare date cutoff classing anything pre-2026-08-05 as debt
the_five_causes_each_measured_not_guesse.broke: 4 cases planting falsified numbers in files dated 2026-08-04
the_five_causes_each_measured_not_guesse.why: a falsified number is not stale merely because the file it sits in is old
the_five_causes_each_measured_not_guesse.fix: scope the cutoff to the ONE check the debt is made of — worklog-timestamp

the_five_causes_each_measured_not_guesse.cause: metrics-reproducible-not-derivable included in the debt set
the_five_causes_each_measured_not_guesse.fix: removed; the debt is 23 worklog-timestamp findings and nothing else

the_five_causes_each_measured_not_guesse.why: their planted number derives via sqlite, so skipping it made the defect report source_missing — unverifiable rather than wrong — and the gate correctly declined to fire
the_five_causes_each_measured_not_guesse.fix: those two cases now run the sqlite derivation

the_five_causes_each_measured_not_guesse.cause: unverifiable never gates (added for locked databases)
the_five_causes_each_measured_not_guesse.why: a corrupt file and a busy database both reached a bare catch { derived = null } and collapsed to the same status
the_five_causes_each_measured_not_guesse.fix: preserve the failure reason: a parse error is status source-corrupt and GATES; a lock or missing file stays unverifiable and does not

three_wrong_guesses_i_measured_and_disca: explained < count, metric_count_findings, and declaredChecked were each identical broken and healthy; only metrics-reproducible-not-derivable moved (2 -> 0)
the_lesson: every one of these filters was correct for the case it was written for and wrong the moment it was applied to every check. A filter is a claim about which findings do not matter, and it needs the same proof as the finding itself.
